digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria overlay and coaching moves
propositions: A plan-review-only criterion project.symbol-reference-completeness detects plans whose affected-file/call-site inventory was hand-enumerated or is incomplete, coaching re-derivation with Serena symbol tools plus a string-literal sweep the LSP cannot resolve.
The criterion routes to plan_review only because a project.* id can never enter code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would register as a permanently dead move.
The criterion is advisory via default_posture and carries no blocking_enabled key, since plan-review's threshold_for never reads that code-review-only field.
Code-review moves were already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring was added.
Live runs proved detection fires reliably at validity 1.0 naming omitted files including a monkeypatch.setattr site, while the same criterion against a remediated plan correctly fires nothing.

AC5 (a move appearing in a real run's output) cannot be guaranteed: the overlay deterministically makes the move applicable but the coach LLM controls selection and preferred built-in moves, so the move was offered but never selected.
